description: Lands a Solana swap built by /solana/swap/order: send the base64 transaction signed by the taker wallet plus the request_id and Jupiter broadcasts it with priority fees and confirmation handling. Returns the on-chain signature, an explorer link and the amounts actually moved, or a status of failed with the error code so the caller requests a fresh order. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

last_valid_block_height.description: Optional block height from /order for nonce validation

signed_transaction.description: Base64 transaction from /order, signed by the taker
